rationale: The telemetry data shows that the robot experienced a high number of line loss events (2 in the first trial and 1 in the second), indicating issues with path following. To address this, I have increased the body width and wheel track to 0.18 for improved stability and control. Additionally, I have set the base speed to 0.6 to enhance responsiveness. These changes are expected to reduce line loss events and improve overall performance in future trials.
